title: Ruling on Motion for Stay Issued by Chief ALJ Melanie Verzwyvelt

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                      ADMINISTRATIVE HEARINGS DIVISION


                                    DOCKET NUMBER U-37882


                             ENTERGY LOUISIANA, LLC, EX PARTE


          In re:   Application for certification of generation and transmission resources
                                          and for other relief



                               RULIN G ON MOTION FOR STAY


         On July 14, 2026, Meta Platforms, Inc. (“Meta”) ﬁled the following motions in response


to the Tribunal’s July   10, 2026 Ruling on Motionfor Subpoenafor the Production of Documents


(“Subpoena Ruling”). and accompanying Subpoena_ for Production ofDocuments (“Subpoena”):

   0     Motion to Enroll Counsel ofRecord‘/or Limited Appearance ofNon—Party Meta Platforms.

         1nc.;


    0
         Non-Party    Meta  Platforms. Inc. ‘s Motion for Stay Pending     Immediate   Review   of
         Interlocutory Ruling (“Motion for Stay”);

    0
         Non-Party Meta Platforms. Inc. ‘s Motion for Immediate Review of Interlocutory Ruling
         and Memorandum of Law in Support Thereof (“Motion for Immediate Review”);


    0
         Requestfor Protectionfrom Hearing Dates by Counsel for Meta Platforms, Inc.; and
                                                                _




    0    Motion to  Quash Subpoena Issued by the Tribunal to Non-Party Meta Platforms, Inc.
         (“Motion to Quash”).

         HAVING CONSIDERED the Motion for Stay, the Tribunal ﬁnds good cause pursuant to


Rule 57(4) of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure to stay the Subpoena Ruling and


accompanying Subpoena until Meta's pending Motion for Immediate Review and Motion to Quash

can be   considered. Accordingly,


         PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that the Motion for Stay is granted.
          PLEASE TAKE FURTHER NOTICE that, in accordance with Rule 57(2), parties have


                                                                                                  that any
ten   days to ﬁle an opposition memorandum to Meta’s Motion for Immediate Review, and

additional deadlines on the Motion to Quash will be noticed separately.


         Baton Rouge, Louisiana, this 14th day of July, 2026.




                                                                       Melanie Ve     wylx/‘elt
                                                                  Chief Administra ive Law Judge
